description:
About our brand and products:

Little Bond Co. creates premium bamboo baby essentials designed for little moments. Our collections feature buttery-soft bamboo pajamas, cozy triple-layer blankets, and limited-edition prints made for babies and toddlers. We focus on comfort, softness, and elevated designs families genuinely love to use every day.

What makes us different:

We combine premium-quality bamboo fabric with playful, thoughtfully designed prints and small-batch drops. Our products are breathable, stretchy, gentle on sensitive skin, and designed to grow with little ones. We care deeply about branding, community, and creating products parents are excited to share online.

How affiliates can earn:

Approved affiliates earn commission on qualifying sales generated through their affiliate links or codes. Top-performing creators may also receive gifting opportunities, exclusive launches, and additional partnership perks.

How to promote us:

We love authentic content including TikToks, Instagram Reels, unboxings, lifestyle photos, “day in the life” content, pack orders, and cozy bedtime moments featuring our products.

Other information:

We are currently looking for creators with babies and toddlers ages 0–24 months who align with our soft, playful, premium aesthetic.

Little Bond Co. Ambassador Program Terms

Effective date: Septemer 2, 2026

These Little Bond Co. Ambassador Program Terms (“Terms”) govern participation in the Little Bond Co. Ambassador Program (“Program”). By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to these Terms.

In these Terms, “Little Bond Co.,” “we,” “our” and “us” refer to LITTLE BOND CO. L.L.C. “Ambassador,” “you” and “your” refer to the individual or business participating in the Program.

1. Program eligibility

To participate, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old;

  • Provide complete and accurate application and payment information;

  • Maintain at least one active and authentic promotional channel, community or audience;

  • Comply with these Terms and all applicable laws; and

  • Reside in a location where participation and payment are legally permitted.

Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance. Applications are reviewed manually, and Little Bond Co. may approve or decline an application at its discretion.

2. Nature of the Program

The Program allows approved Ambassadors to earn commission by referring qualifying customers to Little Bond Co. using an assigned tracking link or discount code.

Acceptance into the Program does not guarantee:

  • Complimentary products;

  • Paid content opportunities;

  • Creator campaigns;

  • Features on Little Bond Co. channels;

  • A minimum level of earnings; or

  • Exclusivity.

Gifted and paid creator campaigns are separate opportunities governed by their own written campaign terms.

Ambassadors are not required to publish a particular number of posts unless they separately accept a campaign containing specific deliverables.

3. Ambassador discount

Approved Ambassadors may receive a personalized discount code offering customers 15% off eligible purchases.

Discount codes:

  • May not be combined with other discounts unless Little Bond Co. expressly permits it;

  • May exclude gift cards, bundles, sale merchandise, limited releases or other designated products;

  • May not be used for self-referrals or purchases made primarily for the Ambassador’s own benefit;

  • May not be altered, duplicated or represented as a coupon issued by another source; and

  • May be modified or deactivated by Little Bond Co.

Eligibility and exclusions displayed during checkout control the customer’s final discount.

4. Commission

Ambassadors earn a commission equal to 10% of qualifying net merchandise sales attributed to their approved tracking link or discount code.

Commission is calculated after applicable discounts and excludes:

  • Shipping charges;

  • Taxes;

  • Tips;

  • Gift-card purchases;

  • Cancelled orders;

  • Refunded or returned merchandise;

  • Fraudulent or disputed transactions;

  • Self-referrals;

  • Orders violating these Terms; and

  • Any other nonqualifying amount identified in the Ambassador dashboard.

Little Bond Co. may reverse or adjust commission associated with a cancellation, return, refund, chargeback, duplicate transaction, tracking error or violation of these Terms.

Special commission rates may occasionally be offered in writing. Unless otherwise stated, the standard 10% rate applies.

5. Tracking and attribution

The Program uses tracking links, cookies and personalized discount codes administered through UpPromote.

The standard tracking period is 30 days, subject to browser settings, customer behavior and technical limitations. Tracking is not guaranteed when cookies are blocked, deleted or unavailable.

Attribution will generally be determined using the records available through Little Bond Co.’s store and affiliate platform. Little Bond Co. may investigate and correct tracking errors at its reasonable discretion.

6. Commission approval and payment

Commissions remain pending until the associated order has been reviewed and the applicable return period has passed.

Approved commissions will be paid:

  • Monthly;

  • After the Ambassador’s approved balance reaches at least $25; and

  • Through an available payment method selected in the Ambassador account.

Balances below $25 will roll forward to the next payment period.

Ambassadors are responsible for maintaining accurate payment information. Little Bond Co. is not responsible for delays caused by incomplete or incorrect payment details.

7. Taxes

Ambassadors are responsible for all taxes, reporting obligations and expenses arising from Program earnings.

Little Bond Co. may request tax documentation when required by law. Failure to provide requested documentation may delay payment or result in suspension from the Program.

8. Required advertising disclosures

Ambassadors must clearly and conspicuously disclose their relationship with Little Bond Co. whenever promoting or endorsing the brand.

A disclosure must:

  • Appear with the endorsement itself;

  • Be easy for an ordinary viewer to notice and understand;

  • Be placed before a “more” button or similar content break when applicable;

  • Appear in the content—not only in the caption—when the endorsement is communicated through video;

  • Be repeated when necessary in livestreams or temporary content; and

  • Identify commissions, free products, payments or other material benefits accurately.

Appropriate disclosures may include:

  • “I earn commission when you shop through my link.”

  • “Little Bond Co. affiliate.”

  • “Thanks to Little Bond Co. for the gifted product.”

  • “Paid partnership with Little Bond Co.”

  • “#ad” or “#sponsored,” when appropriate.

A personalized discount code by itself may not adequately disclose that the Ambassador earns commission.

Ambassadors must follow the current Federal Trade Commission Endorsement Guides, platform disclosure requirements and any other applicable advertising laws.

9. Honest content and prohibited claims

All statements about Little Bond Co. must reflect the Ambassador’s honest opinions and actual experience.

Ambassadors may not:

  • Make false, misleading or unsubstantiated claims;

  • Make medical, health or safety claims that Little Bond Co. has not expressly authorized in writing;

  • Misrepresent product materials, features, pricing or availability;

  • Guarantee results or customer experiences;

  • Present personal opinions as official Little Bond Co. statements;

  • Imply that Little Bond Co. reviewed or approved content when it did not; or

  • Publish content that is unlawful, discriminatory, threatening, sexually explicit or otherwise damaging to the brand.

Nothing in these Terms requires an Ambassador to provide a positive review or conceal an honest opinion.

10. Promotional restrictions

Unless Little Bond Co. provides prior written permission, Ambassadors may not:

  • Purchase advertising using “Little Bond Co.,” its misspellings or other brand trademarks as keywords;

  • Run paid advertisements that link directly to Little Bond Co.;

  • impersonate Little Bond Co. or create accounts that appear to be official brand accounts;

  • Register domains, usernames or social accounts containing Little Bond Co. trademarks;

  • Post codes to coupon, discount or deal websites;

  • Use spam, unsolicited bulk messages or misleading promotions;

  • Send marketing messages in violation of email, telephone or privacy laws;

  • Place links or codes on websites containing unlawful or harmful material;

  • Purchase through their own link or arrange artificial referrals;

  • Mislead customers about discounts, scarcity or program affiliation; or

  • Recruit sub-affiliates unless Little Bond Co. expressly authorizes it.

Ambassadors may share their approved link and code through their authentic content, website, email audience, social platforms and personal communities, subject to platform rules and applicable law.

11. Brand assets and intellectual property

Little Bond Co. grants approved Ambassadors a limited, revocable, nonexclusive and nontransferable right to use approved brand names, product images and promotional materials solely to participate in the Program.

Ambassadors may not modify logos, remove copyright or trademark notices, or use Little Bond Co. intellectual property in a manner that suggests ownership or official company status.

The Ambassador retains ownership of content they independently create. Participation in the Program does not automatically grant Little Bond Co. the right to reuse that content.

Any reposting, advertising usage, editing rights or other content license must be granted separately by the Ambassador or included in a separate creator campaign agreement.

12. Confidential information and launch materials

Ambassadors may occasionally receive early-access information or unreleased materials. Information identified as confidential or embargoed may not be shared before the approved date.

Early access does not guarantee inventory availability, product allocation or participation in a launch campaign.

13. Independent relationship

Ambassadors participate as independent contractors. Nothing in these Terms creates an employment, agency, partnership, franchise or joint-venture relationship.

Ambassadors may not enter into agreements, make commitments or incur obligations on behalf of Little Bond Co.

Ambassadors are responsible for their own equipment, expenses, work methods and compliance obligations.

14. Monitoring and enforcement

Little Bond Co. may review promotional activity, referral patterns, disclosures and use of brand materials to protect customers and maintain Program integrity.

If Little Bond Co. identifies a potential violation, it may:

  • Request that content be corrected or removed;

  • Place commissions under review;

  • Reverse commission associated with prohibited activity;

  • Suspend links or codes; or

  • Terminate participation.

Failure to correct a disclosure or misleading claim after receiving notice may result in immediate suspension or termination.

15. Term and termination

Either party may end participation at any time.

Little Bond Co. may immediately suspend or terminate an Ambassador for fraud, deceptive conduct, brand impersonation, prohibited advertising, failure to disclose the relationship, abuse of discounts or other material violations.

After termination:

  • The Ambassador must stop representing themselves as a Little Bond Co. Ambassador;

  • Little Bond Co. may deactivate associated links and codes;

  • Permission to use Little Bond Co. brand assets ends; and

  • Valid approved commissions earned before termination will remain payable, except those connected to fraud, prohibited conduct or violations of these Terms.

16. Program changes

Little Bond Co. may modify the Program, commission rates, discount terms, eligibility requirements or these Terms.

When reasonably practical, material changes will be communicated through email, the Ambassador dashboard or the Program webpage. Continued participation after the effective date of updated Terms constitutes acceptance of those changes.

17. Disclaimer and limitation of liability

The Program, tracking tools and related materials are provided on an “as available” basis. Little Bond Co. does not guarantee uninterrupted tracking, particular sales results, customer purchases or any minimum level of earnings.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Little Bond Co. will not be responsible for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or lost-profit damages arising from participation in the Program.

Nothing in these Terms excludes any right or liability that cannot legally be excluded.

18. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Kentucky, without regard to its conflict-of-law principles.

Any dispute relating to these Terms or the Program will be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Jefferson County, Kentucky and each party consents to that jurisdiction and venue.

19. Contact

Questions about the Ambassador Program or these Terms may be sent to:

Little Bond Co.
PO BOX 20215 Louisville, KY 40250
collabs@littlebondco.com

By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to these Little Bond Co. Ambassador Program Terms.
